foundation.why: Your warm skin has golden or yellow undertones. Golden Beige matches these undertones seamlessly so your foundation blends naturally without looking ashy or too pink.

blush.why: Peach and coral shades share warm undertones with your skin, creating a natural healthy flush. These shades enhance your golden glow without clashing with your complexion.

eyeshadow.why: Bronze and warm brown shades share the same golden undertones as your skin, creating a harmonious look. These earthy tones enhance your eyes without overpowering your warm complexion.

mascara.why: Mascara defines and opens up your eyes for any casual everyday look. Black suits all skin tones while dark brown gives a softer more natural effect for daytime wear.

lipstick.shade: Tinted lip balm or Nude Pink gloss
lipstick.why: Oval face shape is the most balanced and versatile. A simple tinted lip balm keeps your look effortlessly casual and lets your natural features shine without overcomplicating the look.

oval.face_tip: Your oval face shape is the most versatile! Almost any makeup style works well for you.
